text.p: SKOPJE, Dec 11 (Retuer) - These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian and Greek railway companies agreed to reduce transport costs between the two countries by 60 percent.
- Greek farmers' road blockade causes problems for many truck drivers. A backlog of more than 20 trucks formed at the Gevgelija border crossing on Tuesday.
- The opposition ethnic Albanian PDPA party accused the ruling PDP party of stealing 580 ballots in the Tetovo municipality.

- Macedonian Association of Journalists protested against alleged physical attacks on journalists during the local elections and demanded protection from police. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
